about: The id each experiment prints under, when it differs from the one its folder declares. An id once printed is never reused (lab/README.md, The build): the lab PDF printed LAB 04 as the designer's condensed storyboard first, so ruv.sgit's next two print as LAB 05 and LAB 06 (their folders declare so since 30 October 2026, 23:28 UTC; the map entries are gone). Experiments under held are left out of the print, with the reason, until the designer's verdict changes.
